scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start: npm run docker:dev && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.docker:rebuild: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.db:push: docker compose exec backend npx prisma db push
scripts.db:generate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma generate
scripts.db:studio: docker compose exec backend npx prisma studio
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec backend npm run seed
scripts.db:reset: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:up && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.docker:dev: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
